name: cmp
doc:
cmp: comparisons generic over the builtin Ordered constraint
(integers, floats, string, char). For floats, NaN compares less than
every other value and equal to NaN (as in Go's cmp.Compare).

items.name: Clamp
items.signature: func Clamp<T: Ordered>(x T, lo T, hi T) T
items.doc: x limited to [lo, hi]. Panics if lo > hi.

items.name: Compare
items.signature: func Compare<T: Ordered>(a T, b T) int
items.doc: -1 if a < b, 0 if a == b, +1 if a > b.
items.summary: -1 if a < b, 0 if a == b, +1 if a > b.

items.name: Less
items.signature: func Less<T: Ordered>(a T, b T) bool
items.doc: True if a < b (NaN is less than everything else).
items.summary: True if a < b (NaN is less than everything else).

items.name: Max
items.signature: func Max<T: Ordered>(a T, b T) T
items.doc: The larger of a and b (a if equal).
items.summary: The larger of a and b (a if equal).

items.name: Min
items.signature: func Min<T: Ordered>(a T, b T) T
items.doc: The smaller of a and b (a if equal).
items.summary: The smaller of a and b (a if equal).

items.name: Or
items.signature: func Or<T: Comparable>(a T, b T) T
items.doc: The first argument that is not the zero value (or the zero value).
items.summary: The first argument that is not the zero value (or the zero value).
